_about: W81 (defect D20): CIQ's annual LTM EBITDA against its four quarters, and the cause the LTM check names (2026-11-19). Cut at main ac3c9479 from each page's OWN Financials exports, found by the sha256 its inputs.ciq records (each workbook's sha256 is below), read through vinci.dossier.ciq's real decode path. Kept: each sheet's period-header row whole; on the two Income Statements the rows the LTM check reads (the annual summary's core money rows, 'EBIT', and the unusual-items block with its delimiters), values only in the LTM column (annual) or the four quarters ending on it (quarterly); on the annual Cash Flow, 'Depreciation & Amort., Total' and 'Other Amortization', the LTM column only. Every other row is an empty row, so each kept row keeps its position in the export. DERIVED values only; the workbooks are never committed.
